title: Kiritani Haruka — Get Closer & Work Together〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's this shelf all sorted. Next, I'll start working on my desk.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We've been so busy lately that I need to take every chance I get to clean my room.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Haruka!
I wanna ask you something about this dance routine I've been practicing...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Rin? Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh no!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: O-Oww...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <H-Haruka?! Are you okay?! That was a pretty loud thud...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I-I'm okay...
I was cleaning up, and I sort of hit my head on the desk, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What?! Is it because I surprised you?! I-I'm so sorry!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's not your fault, Rin.
I was just careless.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, you said something about a dance routine?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, you don't have to help if you're still cleaning!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Also, good for you for cleaning your room!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, those papers on your bed...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <They all say “Audition Application” at the top... Oh, does that mean...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, they're my old resumes.
Just practice ones, though. I found them while cleaning.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I knew it!
Can I take a closer look at them? Please!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sure.
I'll move them closer so you can see them better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay! Thanks, Haruka♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wow, your handwriting's amazing!
It's identical to the way you write now!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <No, wait. Did you use to write a little bigger?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha. You got me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, why's the part where you talk about yourself all covered in red ink...?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah, those are my mom's corrections.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Really? Lemme see...
“Talk about just one thing you're best at, and one thing you want to do!”
“Answer the question first. Explain your reasoning after!”>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember her giving me other comments, too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Still, these really take me back.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I didn't know what I was supposed to write, but I knew for certain that I wanted to become an idol. And my mom was there to make corrections for me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I remember feeling so nervous after sending in my applications.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, at the end, you wrote, “I want to become an idol who can spread hope to others”!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, that has always been what's driven me.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: She said that it's an idol's duty to spread hope to others and make them smile...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: I want to spread hope to others the way she does... I want to make lots and lots of people smile...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: I want to become an idol too...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Ever since the day she gave me my dream.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Thanks for showing me these, Haruka!
Oh, what's this piece of paper?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is a clipping of the interview that the producer of ASRUN did.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Huh? Of ASRUN?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I decided to apply to join ASRUN after reading this article.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After seeing “idols are supposed to spread hope to others” in print.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, that means...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes.
His words matched up with my dream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why I became convinced that I could make it come true by joining his agency.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And I'm so glad I applied.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I got to join ASRUN, make a lot of different dreams come true and spread hope to countless people.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, things ended with us disbanding...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I've been able to take what I experienced with ASRUN and keep spreading hope to others.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And I'm going to keep doing my best.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (So that we're able to spread hope to people all across Japan.)
